obs: "we must take care that in the exercise of it the facts giving jurisdiction plainly appear, and *371 that the terms of the statute are complied with." ... "The jurisdiction in such cases... must appear by the record; and everything will be presumed to be without the jurisdiction which does not distinctly appear to be within it."
Washington & Georgetown Railroad v. District of Columbia
“The inquiry at once arises in this case, therefore, whether it appears from the record that the matter in dispute, exclusive of costs, exceeds the sum of five thousand dollars.”
